svg.title: Gyroscope precession
svg.desc: A spinning gyroscope supported at one end of its axle precesses about the vertical. Gravity’s torque is horizontal and perpendicular to the angular momentum, so the angular momentum turns sideways; a top view shows the change along the torque. Animated motion has a static alternative for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Torque turns a gyroscope’s angular momentum sideways
Gravity’s torque is horizontal and perpendicular to L, so L swings around instead of tipping down:
precession at Ω = τ / L. Oblique view; rates schematic.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
